summary: Stone lookout on Carbon County's Bridger Peak: planned in 1911, dated 1925 by the register, removed in the 1960s; a foundation and radio site remain.

facts.design: Stone walls described as very thick, a small window facing each direction and a platform on top (oral history quoted in the register)
facts.status_note: Register says the lookout was removed in the 1960s; a rock foundation and a radio facility remain on the summit.

access.note: Two trip reports (2022 and 2026) describe hiking to the summit by the Continental Divide Trail or a forest road, and neither mentions a closure. Inferred from those accounts; no official access statement was found.

visit.trail_note: 2022 hike started at the trailhead on the south side of Battle Pass and followed the ridge. A 2026 hike went up the Continental Divide Trail, with the forest road planned as the way back.

events.note: Plan announced for a stone and cement station with a man kept there in summer. The item does not confirm a build.
Lookout house in use: sixty persons signed the travelers' register that summer
Register's build year. A 1921 item already mentions the lookout house, so the building may be older.
Register says removed in the 1960s; 1960 is approximate

corrections.proposed: Earlier than 1925: a lookout house was in use by 1921. The register's 1925 date can stay as the register's own date, with this caveat.
corrections.why: A 1921 newspaper item, reprinted on westlookouts, describes registrants signing in at the lookout house on the peak that summer, which a 1925 first build does not allow.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and the 2026 trip account give 11,004 feet; firelookout.com gives 11,007 feet. The story uses 11,004 and reports the other figure.
Register gives 1925. A 1921 newspaper item describes a lookout house already on the peak, and the 1911 papers report only a plan. The story reports both and does not pick a date.
A 1911 newspaper item names the Hayden National Forest; the register places the peak in the Medicine Bow-Routt National Forests.

sources.title: Wyoming Hiked: Bridger Peak on the Continental Divide Trail

notes_for_editor: Build year is the open point. The register says 1925, but a 1921 newspaper item describes a lookout house on the peak, and the 1911 papers only report a plan. The story reports both and proposes no date. Public access is inferred from two trip reports; no official statement was found. Newspaper items are quoted from westlookouts.weebly.com, which reprints them; the original papers were not read. The register's registration date (January 1, 2026) was confirmed on the page. No photo was added; no licensed image source was found. The record's 1960 removal year is approximate, since the register says only 1960s.
